data.revised_english: Neither the man nor the woman had yet a single wrinkle in the face. But in the shade of his thick eyebrows his hollowed, kind-looking eyes showed a weary colour of tiredness. And in her dark hair and about her slight shoulders could be seen a still deeper, sunken tiredness, and a drowsy peace.
